title: AoT error with interface in type of @Component's constructor parameters

labels.name: area: core
labels.description: Issues related to the framework runtime

body:

' +}) +export class BugComponent { + constructor( + public data: { prop: IInterface } + ) { } +} diff --git a/src/app/app.module.ts b/src/app/app.module.ts index 67ae491..d43010b 100644 --- a/src/app/app.module.ts +++ b/src/app/app.module.ts @@ -3,11 +3,12 @@ import { NgModule } from '@angular/core'; import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms'; import { HttpModule } from '@angular/http'; -import { AppComponent } from './app.component'; +import { AppComponent, BugComponent } from './app.component'; @NgModule({ declarations: [ - AppComponent + AppComponent, + BugComponent ], imports: [ BrowserModule, EOF $ ng serve --prod ``` * **Angular version:** 4.0.0-rc.6 / cli 1.0.0-rc.4 * **Language:** TypeScript * **Node (for AoT issues):** `node --version` = v6.10.0
